Qin Shujian panicked and grabbed his moving hand. He refused with a trembling voice: "No..." Cheng An's fingers slipped through the gaps between hers and intertwined their fingers. The other hand slid to her waist and clasped her waist domineeringly. Her whole body was locked in his arms, unable to move. Qin Shujian struggled slightly but did not move away. She timidly raised her head and looked at him. Cheng An's lips slammed into the corner of her eye. Her slightly trembling eyelashes swept across his lips, tickling him. "What don't you want?" He seemed to have discovered something interesting. The corner of his lips brushed against her trembling eyelashes, and finally fell on her lips again. The breath was so close that she closed her eyes nervously, held her breath, and didn't dare to move. Only the eyelashes that had been brushed by the corners of his lips were still trembling slightly, like small trembling hooks, so attractive. Cheng An made no further moves, but stepped back slightly. Qin Shujian noticed his movement, carefully opened his eyes a crack, and then closed them in a panic as if he was afraid that he would find out. Cheng An felt that his throat was slightly hot, and his voice was a little hoarse, "Xiao Jianjian, I am easy to talk to." Qin Shujian's eyelids moved, he blinked lightly, then quietly opened his eyes and whispered "Huh?" Cheng An took out a finger and scratched her palm lightly, "Kiss me and I'll let you go." "Otherwise, if I change it for you, I'm not sure whether you can still eat this lunch..." Qin Shujian's eyes widened in panic. Cheng An tried his best to flatten the corners of his lips that could barely be suppressed, and stared at her with a cold look on his face. Qin Shujian swallowed, a little scared. But she didn't want him to change her clothes at all... She cheered herself up in her heart, closed her eyes with humiliation, and slowly moved toward his lips. When she was about to get close to him, she couldn't help but whisper, "Is it really just a moment?" Cheng An lowered his head and stared at her lips so close, the fire in his eyes became even hotter. Originally it was OK. But now, I'm afraid it's a bit difficult. However, in order to make himself not look so shameless, he still replied righteously, "You can kiss him twice if you want." Qin Shujian trembled with fright, then quickly leaned over and touched his lips lightly, and then backed away. Just as she pulled away, his lips pressed heavily against her, forcing her to have nowhere to hide and to indulge in his breath again. Qin Shujian struggled and whimpered a few times, only to hear him panting, biting her earlobe and saying, "Xiao Jian, let's reciprocate politely!"... After all, lunch was still a long time late, but when eating steak, Cheng An was very considerate and cut the steak into small pieces for her, put it in front of her, and then served soup and fruit, very attentive. This made Qin Shujian, who was already frightened, even more frightened. Could it be that he wanted to eat her clean again after feeding her? Qin Shujian thought and silently put down the unfinished half bowl of soup. Cheng Anzheng forked a strawberry and handed it to her lips. Seeing her put down the spoon, he asked with a smile, "Why don't you eat it?" Qin Shujian said to her heart, I don't dare to eat it! But I still only dare to cope with it by saying that I am full. But as soon as she said the word "I", he stuffed a whole strawberry into her mouth. The vixen Cheng An on the opposite side glanced at the red marks on her collarbone and said lazily, "Strawberries, they are delicious~" - Please vote for me~
